sources.entry: Netresearch Agentic Skills by Netresearch - Skills for assessing and enhancing software projects to meet enterprise-grade standards for security, quality, and automation. Strong collection covering a range of development frameworks, enterprise-readiness, security, GitHub release management, branding, code review - really useful and well curated.

summary.one_liner: A catalog marketplace of 41 Netresearch-maintained Agent Skills entries (TYPO3, PHP, Go, Docker, Jira, security and docs) that point to separate source package repositories for installation.
summary.what_it_does: This repository is a catalog, not a single skill: it lists 41 entries that each point to a source package repository, and some packages contain several Agent Skills. The README groups them into categories such as Skill-skills, TYPO3 Development, OroCommerce, Code Quality & Security, DevOps & Infrastructure, Productivity & Integration, and Brand & visual identity. Installation is handled per package, through the Claude Code plugin marketplace, a ChatGPT workspace import of a native catalog, or the npx skills CLI. The README describes a validation script and generator (scripts/sync-codex-marketplace.sh, scripts/validate.sh) that keep the Claude and ChatGPT/Codex manifests in sync. It also documents CI checks on pull requests, including dependency review, secret scanning, CodeQL, DCO sign-off, and a site build. The catalog itself is browsable as a website with per-skill detail pages in English and German.
use_cases: Find an Agent Skill for TYPO3 extension development or upgrades
Install coding-agent skills for PHP modernization and security audits
Add GitHub release and branch-protection guidance to a project
Set up Docker, Concourse CI, or Go development guidance for an agent
Give an AI coding agent Jira and German technical writing conventions
Browse and install skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or Codex
notable: Catalog of 41 entries that point to separate source repositories rather than bundling skills
Covers a broad range of stacks, notably TYPO3, OroCommerce, PHP, Go, and Docker
Generates a ChatGPT/Codex catalog from the canonical Claude catalog and validates that both match
Per-skill detail pages on a website, in English and German
caveats: Adding the marketplace does not install all entries; each package is installed separately and installers differ in what components they support
Skill-only installers do not install hooks or commands, and registration does not set up external runtime tools
The ChatGPT import requires a GitHub account that can read every referenced repository and needs workspace admin rights
keywords: find a plugin for my coding assistant
